1.title: Ex-Sheriff’s Deputy Acquitted in Fatal Shooting of Airman Roger Fortson
1.summary: The airman, Roger Fortson, had answered a knock at his home in Fort Walton Beach while holding a gun, and was shot within seconds. A Florida jury cleared the former deputy, Eddie Duran.

2.title: As Midterms Near, Justice Alito Says He Considers Each Year Whether to Retire
2.summary: The justice, the second oldest on the court at 76, told CBS News that he decided against stepping down last term. He could face pressure should Democrats win the Senate in November.

3.title: Trump, Critic of Voting by Mail, Urges Republicans to Do It in Midterms
3.summary: It was the latest mixed messaging from President Trump, who regularly votes by mail, but has made baseless claims that the practice is “inherently corrupt.”

4.title: American High School Students Are Selling Guns Bound for Cartels
4.summary: Drawn by money and status, teenagers in Arizona are buying, stealing and selling weapons destined for criminal groups in Mexico.

5.title: Medical plane with 6 on board missing off Massachusetts coast
5.summary: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.

6.title: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution
6.summary: Pike's lawyers said the failure "goes far beyond any one person". Pike is in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections.
